test_ctc_loss: test the CTCLoss class by comparing its output against PyTorch F.ctc_loss with random logits and targets
run_ctc_loss_test: run the CTCLossTest unit test to verify CTC loss computation matches PyTorch native implementation
create_ctc_loss_config: create a CTCLoss.Config object and set the blank label to 0 for CuDNN support
build_ctc_loss_fn: build a CTCLoss instance from config and call it with logits, targets, input lengths, and target lengths
review_ctc_loss_test: review the CTCLossTest class and test_ctc_loss method to understand CTC loss validation against PyTorch
